pageDescriptionEmpty: Members and guests of your club.
pageDescription: Everyone in your club – with or without a login. They appear in attendance, fines and tasks.

emptyState.title: No members yet
emptyState.description: Add members individually or import an existing list – they'll then be available for attendance, todos and fines.

emptyFiltered: No members found for the current filter.

csvPreview.title: CSV preview
csvPreview.description: {count, plural, =0 {No entries recognized.} one {# entry recognized.} other {# entries recognized.}}
csvPreview.columns: Recognized columns: Vorname, Nachname, Übername (or Anzeigename), Firmenname, Haupt-E-Mail (or E-Mail) – English headers such as First name, Last name, Email also work. Separator semicolon or comma.
csvPreview.help: People who already exist (same display name or same email) are skipped. New people get the «Reader» role and no login.
csvPreview.noRows: No person was recognized in this file. Check the column names in the first row or use the template.
csvPreview.noEmailColumn: No email column recognized: the people will be imported without an email address.

editModal.description: Master data, membership and templates. Roles are assigned under «Logins & roles».
editModal.joinedAtHint: Only appears in attendance lists from this date on. Empty = no start date set.
editModal.leftAtHint: No longer appears in attendance lists from the next day on. Empty = no leave date set.
editModal.notifyWithoutLogin: Send email notifications even though this person has no login
editModal.notifyWithoutLoginHint: New tasks and reminders go to the stored email address.
editModal.notifyWithoutLoginHelp: People without a login only receive emails if you switch this on: new tasks and reminders to the stored address. Without a login the person cannot unsubscribe themselves.
editModal.notifyWithoutLoginNeedsEmail: This requires an email address for the person.
editModal.membershipHelp: Joining and leaving dates control which attendance lists the person appears in. «Inactive» marks the person as no longer active and blocks a login without deleting data.

toasts.leftBeforeJoined: Leave date cannot be before the join date
toasts.deleteConfirmMessage: Permanently delete member? This cannot be undone.
toasts.bulkDeleteConfirmMessage: Permanently delete {count} members? This cannot be undone.

personalData.title: Personal data of {name}
personalData.description: All data stored in hocX about this person as a password-protected ZIP file (Excel and JSON). The download is recorded in the activity log.

invite.title: Invitation by email
invite.hint: Instead of setting a password: the person receives a link and sets their own password. Sign-in becomes active once they accept the invitation.
invite.needsEmail: An invitation needs a saved email address for this person.
invite.pendingQueued: The invitation will be sent shortly.
invite.revokeConfirm: Withdraw the invitation to {name}? The link in the email will no longer work.
invite.sentToast: The invitation to {email} is being sent.
invite.failed: The invitation could not be processed.
invite.mailOff: Email invitations are not possible because email sending is not set up.
invite.saveEmailFirst: The email address was changed: save first, then invite.

deleteDialog.title: Permanently delete «{name}»?
deleteDialog.message: The person disappears together with attendance, fines and task assignments; this cannot be undone. If they have only left, better set a leave date or «Inactive».
deleteDialog.messageWithLogin: The person disappears together with their login, attendance, fines and task assignments; this cannot be undone. If they should just no longer sign in, revoke the login instead (under «Logins & roles»).
deleteDialog.bulkTitle: {count, plural, one {Permanently delete # person?} other {Permanently delete # people?}}
deleteDialog.bulkMessage: The people disappear together with logins, attendance, fines and task assignments; this cannot be undone. For members who have left, better set a leave date.
